description: This file defines a comprehensive client-side SDK for embedding booking and scheduling components into web pages. It manages iframe creation, modal dialogs, inline embeds, event handling, configuration, and communication between parent and iframe contexts. It also supports prerendering, theme adaptation, and namespace management for multiple instances.

classes.name: Cal
classes.description: Main class managing iframe creation, modal dialogs, inline embeds, event handling, and communication for the embedded booking components.

classes.name: CalApi
classes.description: API class providing methods for initializing namespaces, creating inline embeds, modals, preloading, prerendering, and event subscriptions.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Simple payload validator for input data based on schema.

methods.name: withColorScheme
methods.description: Augments embed config with the webpage's color scheme to ensure transparent backgrounds.

methods.name: initializeGlobalCalProps
methods.description: Initializes global Cal object properties like version, fingerprint, and CSS.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs messages to internal queue and console if logging is enabled.
